function.name: subagent_followup
function.description: Cancel a subagent's current task and start a new one with the given message. Use this to retask a persistent (manual) subagent that is still alive. One-shot (auto) subagents finish on their own and report back automatically.

agent.description: The id of the subagent to retask (e.g. "agent-7"), as returned by subagent_spawn or subagent_list.

message.description: The new task input for the subagent.
